work.title: Untitled (Targets and Discs) 2
work.description: Panoramic mixed-media collage combining compact discs, vinyl records, and target rings across multiple overlapping panels. Central panel features an ink figure drawing amid bullseye motifs; iridescent CD fans and silver-foil elements punctuate the composition throughout.
work.composition: multi-panel horizontal triptych with overlapping layers
keywords: multi-panel collage with CD and vinyl record motifs
ink figure drawing amid target rings
